# Bill (`bill` v1)

A bill in the legislature: sponsor, stage, votes at each reading, and its fiscal cost.

**Group:** Politics and society · **Mnemonic:** `BILL` · **Identifiers:** `BILL-…` in `billId`

Open one with `BILL <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: bill
version: 1
description: "A bill in the legislature: sponsor, stage, votes at each reading, and its fiscal cost."
match: { kind: bill, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Politics and society · Bill, id: $.billId }
strip:
  - { label: Bill, bind: $.title }
  - { label: Sponsor, bind: $.sponsorName }
  - { label: Stage, bind: $.stage, tone: status, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Introduced, bind: $.introduced, fmt: date }
  - { label: "Cost (5y, m)", bind: $.costM, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: stages
    kind: ladder
    title: Stages
    key: F2
    rows: $.stages
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Stage, bind: "@.stage" }
      - { label: For, bind: "@.for", fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Against, bind: "@.against", fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Outcome, bind: "@.outcome", tone: status }
  - id: summary
    kind: kv
    title: Summary
    area: right
    rows: $.summary
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.sponsor, 'candidate')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
